subject: Shiny Dashboard - widget placement inside a box

messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: Shiny Dashboard - widget placement inside a box
parts:
Hello,

I was wondering if it was possible to control the placement of a widget (eg selectInput) that is placed inside a box. For instance, can i specify that the widget be centered relative to the box boundries?

Thank you

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Dashboard - widget placement inside a box
parts:
That should be possible, although you may need to place a div inside the box, and then give the div some css styling to center it, with something like this:
box(
  div(style="width: 50%; margin: 0 auto;",
    selectInput( ... )
  )
)

parts:
Thanks for the quick reply. Is it possible to center ONLY the widget and NOT its label.

The situation I am facing is one where: the box is wide, which allows the label to fit nicely inside (taking the whole width of the box); but i don't want to widget to be left justify. So i guess, what i would like to do, is center only the "drop list" and not the label associated with it.

Is that possible?

Thanks again!

messages.subject: Re: Shiny Dashboard - widget placement inside a box
parts:
I think you could probably use a NULL label and add a separate div with text above the selectInput.

like:

box(
  div("Some label"),
  selectInput("select1", label=NULL, ....)
)

You might need to do some styling for the div text to look the way you want.
